# AeroWidescreen PCSX2-Cheats: Burnout 3 (SLUS-21050)

Copied unchanged from [AeroWidescreen/PCSX2-Cheats](https://github.com/AeroWidescreen/PCSX2-Cheats/tree/main/Burnout%203%20Takedown/SLUS-21050)
at commit `ab043ba5adb9e65837fd451d207e6c7c2731c3b1`, under its MIT licence ([LICENSE](LICENSE),
copyright (c) 2023 Aero_).

| File | Author | What |
|---|---|---|
| [SLUS-21050_BEBF8793_widescreen.pnach](SLUS-21050_BEBF8793_widescreen.pnach) | Aero_ | 16:9 field of view, HUD, menus, crash camera, replay bars and globe |
| [SLUS-21050_BEBF8793_buttons.pnach](SLUS-21050_BEBF8793_buttons.pnach) | Ookami & Aero_ | Remaps the gameplay controls |

`BEBF8793` is PCSX2's CRC of the retail executable `SLUS_210.50`. Every address these patches touch is
described in the [retail memory map](../../../../docs/reference/retail-memory-map.md).
